examples.en: Profile first, optimize second — my guess about the bottleneck was wrong twice this year.
examples.zh: 先分析再优化，我今年已经猜错两次瓶颈了。

entries.note: measure, don't guess 是性能优化的第一信条；profile first 是它最常见的口头版本。

situation.en: Before we rewrite anything, profile first — data over opinions.
situation.zh: 团队想直接重写慢模块，你拦住说先看数据。

examples.en: The flame graph made it obvious: half the time was going into JSON parsing.
examples.zh: 火焰图让问题一目了然：一半时间花在 JSON 解析上。

situation.en: One look at the flame graph and the hot spot jumps out.
situation.zh: 你向新人介绍火焰图怎么读。

examples.en: Serialization is the hot spot — everything else is noise by comparison.
examples.zh: 序列化就是热点，其他的比起来都是噪声。

situation.en: The profiler says the hot spot moved to the network layer.
situation.zh: 你汇报优化一轮后热点转移了。

entries.zh: 热点（最耗资源的那处代码）

examples.en: Optimizing the hot path bought us forty percent; the cold path nobody touches.
examples.zh: 优化热路径给我们带来了 40% 的提升，冷路径没人碰。

situation.en: Keep the hot path allocation-free.
situation.zh: 你给评审意见：热路径上别分配内存。

entries.zh: 热路径（最常执行的代码）

examples.en: This runs once at startup — it's a cold path, don't waste effort optimizing it.
examples.zh: 这段只在启动时跑一次，是冷路径，别费力气优化它。

situation.en: Cold path, cold rules: correctness first, speed later.
situation.zh: 你给冷路径定优化原则。

entries.zh: 冷路径（很少执行的代码）

examples.en: Our benchmark showed the new parser is twice as fast on real-world files.
examples.zh: 我们的基准测试显示，新解析器在真实文件上快了一倍。

situation.en: Don't trust my laptop numbers — run the benchmark on the CI machine.
situation.zh: 你提醒同事别信本机跑分。

examples.en: Microbenchmarks lie when the JIT would have optimized the real workload differently.
examples.zh: 当 JIT 对真实负载的优化方式不同，微基准就会骗人。

situation.en: That microbenchmark measures the harness, not the code.
situation.zh: 你指出一个微基准测的其实是框架本身。

entries.zh: 微基准（只测一小段代码的）

examples.en: Establish a baseline before the change, or you'll argue about the result forever.
examples.zh: 动手之前先测一个基线，不然结果出来能吵一辈子。

situation.en: Baseline first: current p99 is eight hundred milliseconds.
situation.zh: 优化立项时你先报基线数字。

entries.zh: 基线测量（优化前的对照）

examples.en: The March release had a silent performance regression — twenty percent slower, nobody noticed for weeks.
examples.zh: 三月的版本悄悄出了性能退化，慢了 20%，几周都没人发现。

situation.en: We added alerts to catch performance regressions in CI.
situation.zh: 你介绍怎么防退化再次溜过去。

examples.en: Load testing showed the service falls over at three thousand requests per second.
examples.zh: 压力测试显示，这个服务在每秒三千请求时就趴了。

situation.en: Before the sale, we load test at twice the expected peak.
situation.zh: 你介绍大促前的压测标准。

examples.en: Stress testing isn't about realistic traffic — it's about finding where it breaks.
examples.zh: 极限测试不是模拟真实流量，是找它在哪断裂。

situation.en: Stress test it until something snaps; that's the number I want.
situation.zh: 你给压测同事定目标：测到断为止。

examples.en: The soak test ran for three days and exposed a slow memory leak.
examples.zh: 耐久测试跑了三天，暴露了一个缓慢的内存泄漏。

situation.en: Short tests look fine; the soak test is where leaks confess.
situation.zh: 你解释为什么短测没问题还要跑长测。

entries.zh: 耐久测试（长时间运行看泄漏）

examples.en: Capacity planning says we'll outgrow this cluster in about five months.
examples.zh: 容量规划说，我们大概五个月后就会超出这个集群。

situation.en: Capacity planning is just arithmetic plus honesty about growth.
situation.zh: 你给容量规划祛魅：算术加诚实。

examples.en: Keep thirty percent headroom for spikes, or every sale becomes an incident.
examples.zh: 留 30% 的余量给峰值，不然每次大促都是一次事故。

situation.en: We're running with almost no headroom right now.
situation.zh: 你在会上警告容量余量见底了。

examples.en: At eighty percent CPU, the disks saturate and latency goes nonlinear.
examples.zh: CPU 到 80% 时磁盘就饱和了，延迟开始非线性上升。

situation.en: The thread pool saturates long before the CPU does.
situation.zh: 你指出先饱和的其实是线程池。

examples.en: Lock contention, not CPU, was the ceiling — forty threads fighting over one map.
examples.zh: 天花板是锁竞争不是 CPU：四十个线程抢一个 map。

situation.en: Sharding the lock removed most of the contention.
situation.zh: 你汇报锁分片的优化效果。

examples.en: False sharing: two threads updating different variables that happen to share a cache line.
examples.zh: 伪共享：两个线程更新不同的变量，却恰好在同一条缓存行上。

entries.note: 这是很显功底的一个词，系统面试聊到 CPU 缓存时说出来效果很好。

situation.en: Padding the struct fixed the false sharing problem.
situation.zh: 你介绍一个很底层的优化手法。

examples.en: Cache locality beats clever algorithms at our data sizes — the data fits in L2.
examples.zh: 在我们的数据量下，缓存局部性比聪明的算法更重要，数据能装进 L2。

situation.en: We laid the data out for cache locality, not for elegance.
situation.zh: 你解释数据布局为什么这么摆。

examples.en: The mobile build's memory footprint doubled after we bundled the analytics SDK.
examples.zh: 打包了分析 SDK 之后，移动构建的内存占用翻倍了。

situation.en: On low-end phones, memory footprint is the whole game.
situation.zh: 你强调低端机上内存就是一切。

examples.en: A high allocation rate keeps the garbage collector busy and the tail latency ugly.
examples.zh: 高分配率让垃圾回收器忙个不停，尾延迟很难看。

situation.en: We cut the allocation rate by reusing buffers in the loop.
situation.zh: 你介绍减少分配的改法。

examples.en: A two-hundred-millisecond GC pause during peak traffic shows up as user-visible jank.
examples.zh: 高峰期一次两百毫秒的 GC 停顿，用户能直接感受到卡顿。

situation.en: The pauses correlate exactly with GC pauses, not with deploys.
situation.zh: 你用数据排除部署嫌疑。

examples.en: Our latency budget for the whole request is three hundred milliseconds; the database gets eighty.
examples.zh: 整个请求的延迟预算是三百毫秒，数据库分到八十。

situation.en: That new check costs forty milliseconds of our latency budget.
situation.zh: 评审时你指出新校验的延迟代价。

examples.en: The mean looks fine; the p99 is where users suffer.
examples.zh: 平均值看没事，p99 才是用户受罪的地方。

entries.note: 说延迟永远报分位数不报平均，这个习惯本身就是资深信号。

situation.en: Report the p95 and p99, never just the average.
situation.zh: 你给监控大盘提要求。

examples.en: Median response is fifty milliseconds, but the tail goes to four seconds.
examples.zh: 中位数响应是五十毫秒，但尾巴能拖到四秒。

situation.en: Averages hide the tail — look at the distribution.
situation.zh: 你提醒同事平均数会藏住尾部。

entries.zh: 尾延迟（最慢的那批请求）

examples.en: Every fix moves the bottleneck — first the CPU, then the disk, then the network.
examples.zh: 每次修复都会让瓶颈转移：先是 CPU，再是磁盘，再是网络。

situation.en: We fixed the query; now the bottleneck shifted to serialization.
situation.zh: 你汇报优化的连锁反应。

entries.zh: 瓶颈转移（修好一个冒出下一个）

examples.en: Amdahl's law caps the win: if the serial part is twenty percent, infinite cores still only get you five times.
examples.zh: 阿姆达尔定律给收益封了顶：串行部分占两成，核心再多也只有五倍。

situation.en: Before adding cores, check Amdahl's law — what's the serial fraction?
situation.zh: 你拦住想靠加机器解决问题的同事。

examples.en: Optimizing the report generator was premature optimization — it runs once a night.
examples.zh: 优化报表生成器是过早优化，它一晚上就跑一次。

entries.note: premature optimization is the root of all evil 是 Knuth 的名言，面试里引用恰当很加分，但别滥用。

situation.en: That's premature optimization — measure the real path first.
situation.zh: 你评价一个花哨的优化提案。

examples.en: The ORM was generating an N+1 query for every order on the page.
examples.zh: ORM 为页面上的每个订单都生成了一次额外查询，就是经典的 N+1。

situation.en: Classic N+1 — eager-load the items and it disappears.
situation.zh: 评审时你一眼认出问题并给解法。

examples.en: The query plan shows a full table scan where an index scan should be.
examples.zh: 执行计划显示本该走索引扫描的地方在全表扫描。

situation.en: Let me look at the query plan before guessing.
situation.zh: 遇到慢查询你说先看执行计划。

examples.en: Batching a hundred tiny writes into one cut the I/O by an order of magnitude.
examples.zh: 把一百次小写入合成一次，I/O 降了一个数量级。

situation.en: Batching is boring and it wins almost every time.
situation.zh: 你总结一条朴素经验。

examples.en: Without backpressure, a fast producer will bury a slow consumer in its own queue.
examples.zh: 没有背压，快生产者会用自己的队列把慢消费者埋掉。

situation.en: We added backpressure so the pipeline degrades gracefully.
situation.zh: 你介绍管道的过载保护。

entries.zh: 背压（下游慢时让上游慢下来）

examples.en: Memoization turned an exponential mess into a table lookup.
examples.zh: 记忆化把指数级的灾难变成了查表。

situation.en: Cache it with memoization — the inputs repeat constantly.
situation.zh: 你给重复计算的函数提优化法。

examples.en: The bundle grew by three hundred kilobytes because someone imported a whole library for one function.
examples.zh: 有人为了一个函数引了整个库，包体积涨了三百 KB。

situation.en: Bundle size is a feature on slow networks.
situation.zh: 你强调包体积在弱网下就是功能本身。

examples.en: Code splitting cut the initial load in half — the admin pages load only when visited.
examples.zh: 代码分割把首屏加载砍了一半，管理页访问时才加载。

situation.en: Route-level code splitting is the cheapest win here.
situation.zh: 你给前端性能提第一刀。

examples.en: Virtual scrolling keeps the DOM small even with a hundred thousand rows.
examples.zh: 虚拟滚动让十万行数据时 DOM 也保持很小。

situation.en: Don't render ten thousand rows — virtualize the list.
situation.zh: 评审时你拦住直渲染长列表的实现。

examples.en: The warm-up period pollutes the first minute of every benchmark — discard it.
examples.zh: 预热期会污染基准测试的头一分钟，把它丢掉。

situation.en: Measure in steady state, after warm-up.
situation.zh: 你纠正同事的测试方法。

entries.zh: 稳态（预热后的稳定运行）

examples.en: There's too much jitter in these numbers to conclude anything — run it ten more times.
examples.zh: 这些数字抖动太大，什么结论都下不了，再跑十次。

situation.en: Cloud benchmarks are noisy; jitter is the tax you pay.
situation.zh: 你解释云上跑分的噪声。

entries.zh: 抖动（测量/时延的不稳定）

examples.en: We profile in production with a sampling profiler — the overhead is under one percent.
examples.zh: 我们在生产环境用采样剖析器 profiling，开销不到百分之一。

situation.en: Continuous profiling caught what staging never reproduced.
situation.zh: 你介绍持续剖析抓到的线上问题。

examples.en: The performance gate in CI fails the build if the main bundle grows by more than five percent.
examples.zh: CI 里的性能门禁规定：主包涨超过 5% 就让构建失败。

situation.en: Treat performance budgets like tests — gates, not wishes.
situation.zh: 你主张把性能预算做成硬门禁。

examples.en: Start with the low-hanging fruit: one missing index fixed half the slow queries.
examples.zh: 先摘低垂的果实：补上一个缺失的索引就修好了一半慢查询。

entries.note: low-hanging fruit 是通用职场习语，任何“先做容易的”场景都能用，不限于性能。

situation.en: Before the big rewrite, grab the low-hanging fruit.
situation.zh: 你建议先做容易见效的部分。

entries.zh: 低垂的果实（容易见效的事）
